_comment: The single source of truth for what this app does with data. Three things are generated from it and must never drift apart: ios/App/PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy, store/app_privacy_details.json, and the published privacy policy page. Change this file, re-run the generators, do not hand-edit the outputs.
storesOnDevice: The deal on the table: which deal it is and every move you have made in it, saved as you play so closing the app never costs a hand.
Every deal that came out: the date, its draw and grade, your moves, how many cards you took back, and the card you had to dig for.
Your place in the ledger, and how you are getting on with each kind of deal, which is what the next deal is chosen from.

A few settings: whether you have been through onboarding, whether sounds are on, the cloth and card back you chose, the clock, four-colour suits, large pips, the left-handed table, and the hour of the reminder if you laid one.

requiredReasonAPIs.why: @AppStorage and UserDefaults, used only for this app's own settings: onboarding, sounds and the rating prompt's launch count.

purchases.name: The Drawer
purchases.freeTier: Today's proved deal every day, forever, the whole ledger and loose deals, the diary, the reminder, sounds, the clock, four-colour suits, large pips, and every cloth and back earned by playing. The drawer adds more card backs and cloths, the left-handed table, past days' deals to lay again, and the whole count.

notifications.why: Only if you lay a reminder: one local notification a day at the hour you choose, reading "Today's deal is laid." It is scheduled on your phone and nothing is sent anywhere.

attribution: Baize makes no network connection of any kind. Every deal was proved winnable when the app was built and ships inside it; there is no server to talk to, no account to make, and nothing to sync.
